headline: Argentina Increases Subsidies for 104 Bus Lines to Avert Fare Hikes
summary: The Argentine government confirmed it will disburse additional subsidies starting Sunday to freeze bus fares across 104 national routes, after transport chambers requested 150 billion pesos in sector relief.
why: Public transport subsidies are a contentious element of Argentina's fiscal austerity program, balancing consumer inflation mitigation against Treasury expenditure reduction.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Expanding transport subsidies slightly increases Treasury fiscal outlays.
